# 2209 |
INTED DATE
NAY 20,2026

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the B1-1 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 10-F in the
area bounded by

The public alley next north of and parallel to West 47" Street; a line 56 feet
east of and parallel to South Union Avenue; West 47" Street; and a line 26
feet east of and parallel to South Union Avenue

to those of a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

Section 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 654 W. 47" Street
